name: Floral Ornament
instruction: Design a floral ornament with interwoven petals and leaves.

Shape accuracy: The object is a floral ornament.
The ornament includes leaves that are integrated with the petals.
The petals are shaped to resemble natural flower petals.
The leaves are shaped to resemble natural leaves.
Color representation: The color set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The petals should be proportionate to the leaves.
The overall ornament should have a balanced appearance.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The petals should overlap slightly to create depth.
The leaves should be positioned in a way that they appear to be part of the same structure.
The ornament should have a clear focal point where the petals converge.
Object distance and contact: The petals should not be too far apart to maintain cohesion.
The leaves should connect seamlessly with the petals.
There should be no gaps that disrupt the flow of the design.

Instruction execution accuracy: All specified elements of interwoven petals and leaves are accurately represented.
The design adheres closely to the instruction without deviations.
